method: Read one finalized Reality segment through the repository record decoder. Validate each record's compressed-payload digest and compare the whole-segment SHA-256 with its finalized catalog sidecar. Extract only gap reason and receiver timestamps plus the adjacent preceding and first following frame timestamps.

connection_failure.error: ConnectError: [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution

interpretation.what_this_supports: The sole connection_failure counted in the 20:14 campaign-window summary is the same receiver-time event as the 04:57:26 UTC DNS warning. A later frame record was written 2.445 seconds after that gap event.
not_proven: The first later frame contained a complete snapshot for all eight configured markets.
The public feed was continuously complete before or after this event.
The interval between frames equals exchange-side data unavailability; timestamps are recorder receiver times.
Quote freshness, order arrival, fills, or economic opportunity availability.
